title: 石門水庫大壩
summary: 石門課程從中央心層、濾層、壓實與孔隙水壓開始，再把排砂、分層取水及後池調節納入水量與固體質量帳。學生練習區分土的乾密度與濕密度、濁度與含砂質量濃度，以及排水量上升與內部侵蝕證據。假想地震水平力只用於理解受力，不能替代滑動面或動力分析。
summaryEn: The Shihmen course begins with core zoning, filters, compaction and pore pressure, then brings sediment outlets, selective withdrawal and afterbay buffering into water and solids balances. Learners separate dry from wet density, turbidity from sediment mass concentration, and rising drainage from evidence of erosion. Hypothetical seismic inertia illustrates force bookkeeping without replacing slip-surface or dynamic analysis.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 假想兩層心層厚度各十公尺，滲透係數分別為一乘十的負七次方及五乘十的負八次方公尺每秒，串聯等效係數為六點六六七乘十的負八次方公尺每秒。水頭差三十公尺、截面一千平方公尺時，流量為零點零零零一立方公尺每秒；若低滲透層係數加倍，流量增至零點零零零一五。另以濕密度每立方公尺二千一百公斤及含水率百分之十二得乾密度一千八百七十五公斤每立方公尺，兩個計算不能替代現地壓實曲線與排水觀測。 核驗：L1=10 m; k1=1e-7 m/s; L2=10 m; k2=5e-8 m/s; A=1000 m2; dh=30 m; Q=A dh/(L1/k1+L2/k2)=0.0001 m3/s。以分層測壓點比較各層水頭損失，再用同一流量反算阻力比例。核對室內試體方向與現地壓實方向是否一致，保留溫度與飽和程度，並以排水量獨立檢查總流量而非只信等效係數。
workedExample.textEn: Assume two core layers, each 10 m thick, with permeability values of 1e-7 and 5e-8 m/s. Series resistance gives an equivalent permeability of 6.667e-8 m/s. Across 30 m of head and 1000 m2 of area, flow is 0.0001 m3/s. Doubling the less permeable layer value raises flow to 0.00015 m3/s. Separately, wet density 2100 kg/m3 and gravimetric water content 0.12 imply dry density 1875 kg/m3. These results illustrate different material properties and cannot replace a compaction curve, zoning checks or drainage observations. Verification: Compare head losses across layers using piezometers and infer their resistance ratio from a common discharge. Match laboratory specimen orientation to field compaction, retain temperature and saturation information, and use measured drainage as an independent check on total flow.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 水文條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「分層心層的串聯滲流」與「濾層粒徑比例篩查」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Series seepage through core layers" and "Filter gradation ratio screening": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 分層心層的串聯滲流：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Series seepage through core layers: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「分層心層的串聯滲流」如何影響石門水庫大壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Series seepage through core layers” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Shihmen Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 中央心層靠低滲透材料限制穿壩水量，不同材料沿流向排列時，每層通過相同流量但消耗不同水頭。等效滲透係數因此是厚度加權的調和平均，較不透水的一層可能支配阻力。這與平行流路的算術平均不同，也不能把分層公式套到裂縫形成的集中流，因為後者改變流路與有效截面。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「分層心層的串聯滲流」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A central core limits flow with low-permeability material. Layers arranged along the flow direction carry the same discharge but consume different head losses, giving a thickness-weighted harmonic equivalent permeability. The least permeable layer can dominate resistance. This differs from parallel-path averaging and does not describe a crack carrying concentrated flow, because that feature changes both geometry and the effective flow area. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Series seepage through core layers” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：L1=10 m; k1=1e-7 m/s; L2=10 m; k2=5e-8 m/s; A=1000 m2; dh=30 m; Q=A dh/(L1/k1+L2/k2)=0.0001 m3/s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: L1=10 m; k1=1e-7 m/s; L2=10 m; k2=5e-8 m/s; A=1000 m2; dh=30 m; Q=A dh/(L1/k1+L2/k2)=0.0001 m3/s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「沿流向串聯材料的係數應直接取算術平均」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Permeabilities of layers in series should simply be averaged arithmetically" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「分層心層的串聯滲流」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.title: 分層心層的串聯滲流：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Series seepage through core layers: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「分層心層的串聯滲流」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Series seepage through core layers” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：L1=10 m; k1=1e-7 m/s; L2=10 m; k2=5e-8 m/s; A=1000 m2; dh=30 m; Q=A dh/(L1/k1+L2/k2)=0.0001 m3/s。適用邊界：飽和一維達西流、材料均勻無裂縫，截面固定且無側向逸流。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: L1=10 m; k1=1e-7 m/s; L2=10 m; k2=5e-8 m/s; A=1000 m2; dh=30 m; Q=A dh/(L1/k1+L2/k2)=0.0001 m3/s. Applicable boundary: Saturated one-dimensional Darcy flow through uniform uncracked materials with constant area and no lateral escape. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以分層測壓點比較各層水頭損失，再用同一流量反算阻力比例。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare head losses across layers using piezometers and infer their resistance ratio from a common discharge.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 分層心層的串聯滲流：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Series seepage through core layers: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「分層心層的串聯滲流」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Series seepage through core layers” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以分層測壓點比較各層水頭損失，再用同一流量反算阻力比例。核對室內試體方向與現地壓實方向是否一致，保留溫度與飽和程度，並以排水量獨立檢查總流量而非只信等效係數。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare head losses across layers using piezometers and infer their resistance ratio from a common discharge. Match laboratory specimen orientation to field compaction, retain temperature and saturation information, and use measured drainage as an independent check on total flow. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：把第二層滲透係數加倍，重新求流量與兩層水頭分配，再將層厚互換比較，說明為何幾何與材料阻力必須一起記錄而不能只報一個平均係數。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Double the second permeability, recalculate discharge and head distribution, then interchange layer thicknesses. Explain why geometry and material resistance must be reported together rather than reduced to an unexplained average coefficient.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把兩層係數直接平均會低估低滲透層的控制作用；但若低滲透層已有裂縫，仍堅持完整材料模型又會低估集中流量，兩種錯誤方向並不相同。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Arithmetic averaging underestimates control by the less permeable layer. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 分層心層的串聯滲流：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Series seepage through core layers: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「分層心層的串聯滲流」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Series seepage through core layers” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把兩層係數直接平均會低估低滲透層的控制作用；但若低滲透層已有裂縫，仍堅持完整材料模型又會低估集中流量，兩種錯誤方向並不相同。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。

Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這與平行流路的算術平均不同，也不能把分層公式套到裂縫形成的集中流，因為後者改變流路與有效截面。

steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「沿流向串聯材料的係數應直接取算術平均」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Filter gradation ratio screening” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：D15filter=0.7 mm; d85base=0.25 mm; ratio=D15filter/d85base=2.8。適用邊界：粒徑均為重量通過百分比的同單位數據，只作比值計算，不宣告材料合格。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: D15filter=0.7 mm; d85base=0.25 mm; ratio=D15filter/d85base=2.8. Applicable boundary: Both percentiles use the same size unit and mass-passing convention; this is a ratio calculation, not material acceptance. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：繪完整粒徑曲線並標明取樣位置，確認百分之十五與八十五是通過率而非留置率。

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.instruction: 繪完整粒徑曲線並標明取樣位置，確認百分之十五與八十五是通過率而非留置率。比較施工前後級配與細料遷移試驗，若局部粗化或離析，應另看局部曲線，不能只用整批平均值。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Plot the complete gradation and sampling locations, confirming that fifteen and eighty-five percent denote passing rather than retained mass. steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

steps.title: 含水率與壓實乾密度：機制與系統路徑

steps.objective: 說明「含水率與壓實乾密度」如何影響石門水庫大壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Water content and compacted density” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Shihmen Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 土石壩施工控制不能只看每立方公尺濕土多重，因為其中一部分是水。以水重除乾土重定義的含水率可將濕密度換成乾密度，才便於比較固體骨架壓實程度。相同乾密度也不代表相同滲透性，因為土的組成、含水狀態、壓實能量與顆粒排列仍可能不同。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「含水率與壓實乾密度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「快速降水位與孔壓滯後」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Drawdown and pore pressure lag” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：N=900 kN; u=45 kPa; A=12 m2; Neff=N-uA=360 kN。適用邊界：假想單一面上總法向力與均勻孔壓，未計滑動面需求或外水力矩。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: N=900 kN; u=45 kPa; A=12 m2; Neff=N-uA=360 kN. Applicable boundary: A hypothetical plane with total normal force and uniform pore pressure; slip demand and external-water moments are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：同步繪製庫水位與坡內測壓管歷線，比較峰值及回落的時間差。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Plot reservoir level and slope piezometer histories together to compare peak and recession timing.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 快速降水位與孔壓滯後：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Drawdown and pore pressure lag: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「快速降水位與孔壓滯後」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Drawdown and pore pressure lag” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 同步繪製庫水位與坡內測壓管歷線，比較峰值及回落的時間差。量測點須標明高程和濾管位置，再將多點孔壓分布沿假想面積積分，檢查均勻孔壓近似是否掩蓋局部高壓。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Plot reservoir level and slope piezometer histories together to compare peak and recession timing. Identify sensor elevations and screen positions, then integrate multiple pressures over the hypothetical plane to test whether a uniform approximation hides locally retained pressure. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：另設孔壓只降低十千帕，重算有效力並比較完全排水的極端，指出還需要哪些強度試驗與時程資料，才能把受力示範延伸到坡面穩定分析。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Reduce pore pressure by only ten kilopascals, recalculate effective force and compare with a fully drained extreme. Identify strength tests and time-history data needed before extending the illustration into slope stability analysis.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：以當日庫水位直接替代土體孔壓，會錯誤假設內外同步排水；水位已低但孔壓仍高時，這種代換可能高估有效力而低估降水位後的暫態不利狀態。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Replacing internal pore pressure with that day's reservoir level assumes instantaneous drainage. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 快速降水位與孔壓滯後：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Drawdown and pore pressure lag: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「快速降水位與孔壓滯後」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Drawdown and pore pressure lag” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 以當日庫水位直接替代土體孔壓，會錯誤假設內外同步排水；水位已低但孔壓仍高時，這種代換可能高估有效力而低估降水位後的暫態不利狀態。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Replacing internal pore pressure with that day's reservoir level assumes instantaneous drainage. When the reservoir has fallen but soil pressure remains high, this substitution overstates effective force and hides an adverse transient condition. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：有效正向力計算能展示孔壓滯後對摩擦來源的影響；真正快速降水位問題還需土體不排水強度、滲流時程及滑動幾何，不能僅用一個力值定安全。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: A true rapid-drawdown assessment also requires drainage timescale, appropriate soil strength and slip geometry; a single force calculation cannot establish stability or represent the entire upstream slope during rapidly changing hydraulic and drainage conditions.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「庫水位下降時土內孔壓一定立即等幅下降」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Internal pore pressure always falls immediately by the same amount as reservoir level" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 以當日庫水位直接替代土體孔壓，會錯誤假設內外同步排水；水位已低但孔壓仍高時，這種代換可能高估有效力而低估降水位後的暫態不利狀態。

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「快速降水位與孔壓滯後」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Drawdown and pore pressure lag" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
以當日庫水位直接替代土體孔壓，會錯誤假設內外同步排水；水位已低但孔壓仍高時，這種代換可能高估有效力而低估降水位後的暫態不利狀態。
等效水平力計算完成就能排除地震永久變形
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Replacing internal pore pressure with that day's reservoir level assumes instantaneous drainage.
Calculating equivalent horizontal force rules out permanent seismic deformation
quiz.explanation: 以當日庫水位直接替代土體孔壓，會錯誤假設內外同步排水；水位已低但孔壓仍高時，這種代換可能高估有效力而低估降水位後的暫態不利狀態。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Replacing internal pore pressure with that day's reservoir level assumes instantaneous drainage. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.description: 本階段聚焦「地震慣性力的受力帳」與「泥砂收支與占容轉換」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Seismic inertia force bookkeeping" and "Sediment budget and occupied storage": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 地震慣性力的受力帳：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Seismic inertia force bookkeeping: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「地震慣性力的受力帳」如何影響石門水庫大壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Seismic inertia force bookkeeping” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Shihmen Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 地震加速度使壩體質量產生慣性力，簡化水平係數乘重量可建立靜力等效的受力帳。這個係數無因次，不應與以公尺每秒平方表示的加速度混用。土石壩實際反應還包括動態放大、孔壓增加、永久位移及材料非線性，所以等效力只是受力討論的初步起點。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「地震慣性力的受力帳」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Earthquake acceleration produces inertial force in the embankment mass. A dimensionless horizontal coefficient times weight gives a static-equivalent force for bookkeeping and must not be confused with acceleration in metres per second squared. Actual response also involves amplification, pore-pressure generation, permanent displacement and nonlinear soil behavior, making this equivalent force a starting point rather than a complete site-specific seismic performance assessment. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Seismic inertia force bookkeeping” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：kh=0.15; W=24000 kN; Fh=kh W=3600 kN。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: kh=0.15; W=24000 kN; Fh=kh W=3600 kN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「等效水平力計算完成就能排除地震永久變形」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Calculating equivalent horizontal force rules out permanent seismic deformation" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「地震慣性力的受力帳」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Seismic inertia force bookkeeping”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: Earthquake acceleration produces inertial force in the embankment mass. A dimensionless horizontal coefficient times weight gives a static-equivalent force for bookkeeping and must not be confused with acceleration in metres per second squared.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：等效水平力計算完成就能排除地震永久變形 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Calculating equivalent horizontal force rules out permanent seismic deformation Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「地震慣性力的受力帳」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Seismic inertia force bookkeeping" is correct?
options: 等效水平力計算完成就能排除地震永久變形
入庫泥砂總質量全部等於當期永久庫容損失

optionsEn: Calculating equivalent horizontal force rules out permanent seismic deformation
All incoming sediment mass equals permanent capacity loss in that period

steps.instructionEn: Verify weight from mass times gravity, then independently recover inertia using acceleration equal to the coefficient times gravity. steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Multiplying weight by gravity again introduces an extra gravity factor. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

steps.instruction: 把已是重量的量再乘重力會多出一次重力因子；只檢查等效水平力而忽略變形累積，則可能錯把靜力平衡當成壩頂不沉陷或材料不損傷的證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Multiplying weight by gravity again introduces an extra gravity factor. Checking equivalent force alone while ignoring accumulated deformation can falsely turn static equilibrium into evidence of no crest settlement or material damage. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「等效水平力計算完成就能排除地震永久變形」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Sediment budget and occupied storage” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Shihmen Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 水庫庫容損失來自留下的固體與孔隙空間，而非單純入庫濃度。先用輸入減輸出得到淨沉積質量，再除以沉積乾容重才能估算占容。乾容重會隨顆粒組成、壓密與時間改變，因此每年相同固體質量不必占據相同體積，庫容測量仍是重要獨立證據。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「泥砂收支與占容轉換」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Reservoir capacity loss depends on retained solids and their pore space rather than inlet concentration alone. Net deposited mass is incoming minus outgoing solids, and dry bulk density converts that mass to occupied volume. Bulk density changes with grading, consolidation and age, so equal annual solid masses need not occupy equal volumes; bathymetric capacity surveys remain an important independent line of evidence. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Sediment budget and occupied storage” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.failure: 常見誤解：「入庫泥砂總質量全部等於當期永久庫容損失」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "All incoming sediment mass equals permanent capacity loss in that period" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「泥砂收支與占容轉換」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.objective: 說明「後池吸收放流變化」如何影響石門水庫大壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Afterbay absorption of release changes” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Shihmen Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 後池可暫存上游放流與下游需求之間的差額，降低短時流量波動傳遞。它不是增加總水量的來源，所有暫存都必須在後續時段釋放或保留成庫存。比較容量時應使用可用水位範圍對應的容積，而非整座後池總容量，並明確保留時段開始時的初始蓄量位置。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「後池吸收放流變化」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: An afterbay temporarily stores the difference between upstream release and downstream demand, reducing transmission of short-term fluctuations. It creates no additional water; stored volume must later be released or remain as inventory. Capacity comparison must use the volume available within the relevant level range rather than gross basin capacity, while retaining the initial storage position and the duration of subsequent recovery periods. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Afterbay absorption of release changes” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「後池吸收放流變化」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Afterbay absorption of release changes” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：Qin=18 m3/s; Qout=11 m3/s; dt=2700 s; dV=(Qin-Qout)dt=18900 m3。適用邊界：四十五分鐘恒定差額、無其他入流與蒸發，未指定實際後池容量。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: Qin=18 m3/s; Qout=11 m3/s; dt=2700 s; dV=(Qin-Qout)dt=18900 m3. Applicable boundary: Constant imbalance for forty-five minutes with other inflows and evaporation omitted, without specifying actual afterbay capacity. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：由水位容積曲線計算時段起迄蓄量，與流量差積分互相比較，檢查流量計延遲及回水影響。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Calculate endpoint storage from the level-volume curve and compare with integrated flow imbalance, checking meter lag and backwater effects.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 後池吸收放流變化：試驗與驗證

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「後池吸收放流變化」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Afterbay absorption of release changes” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 由水位容積曲線計算時段起迄蓄量，與流量差積分互相比較，檢查流量計延遲及回水影響。把下一時段回復所需的出入流差也畫上圖，確認緩衝不是靠不斷累積水量維持。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Calculate endpoint storage from the level-volume curve and compare with integrated flow imbalance, checking meter lag and backwater effects. Plot the subsequent imbalance needed for recovery to confirm that buffering does not depend on indefinitely accumulating water. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：設定可用空間只有兩萬立方公尺，計算一次脈衝後剩餘空間，再增加第二次脈衝並求中間必須恢復的水量，將初始狀態畫入水量帳。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Set available space to twenty thousand cubic metres, calculate the remainder after one pulse and add a second pulse. Determine the intervening recovery volume and include the initial state explicitly in the account.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把後池總容積當作每次都能使用的空間，忽略已有蓄水及水位限制；連續多次脈衝若未恢復，會逐漸耗盡緩衝，即使每次單獨計算都小於總容量。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Using gross volume as newly available space ignores existing storage and level constraints. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「後池吸收放流變化」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。

steps.instruction: 把後池總容積當作每次都能使用的空間，忽略已有蓄水及水位限制；連續多次脈衝若未恢復，會逐漸耗盡緩衝，即使每次單獨計算都小於總容量。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。

steps.title: 排水量的水頭正規化：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Head-normalized drainage conductance: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「排水量的水頭正規化」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Head-normalized drainage conductance” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：Q=0.004 m3/s; dh=20 m; G=Q/dh=0.0002 m2/s。適用邊界：單一路徑近似穩態，排除降雨脈衝與出口回水；不是滲透係數本身。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: Q=0.004 m3/s; dh=20 m; G=Q/dh=0.0002 m2/s. Applicable boundary: One approximately steady path excluding rainfall pulses and outlet backwater; conductance is not permeability itself. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將流量與對應時滯後的水頭配對，先標記雨期與清理排水溝日期，再比較乾天穩態區段。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Pair discharge with appropriately lagged head, marking rain periods and drain-cleaning dates before comparing dry steady intervals.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 排水量的水頭正規化：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Head-normalized drainage conductance: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「排水量的水頭正規化」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Head-normalized drainage conductance” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將流量與對應時滯後的水頭配對，先標記雨期與清理排水溝日期，再比較乾天穩態區段。以水溫修正黏度影響時保留修正前曲線，並同步檢查排水濁度與細粒是否出現。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Pair discharge with appropriately lagged head, marking rain periods and drain-cleaning dates before comparing dry steady intervals. Retain uncorrected curves when adjusting for viscosity and examine turbidity and any transported fine particles alongside apparent conductance changes. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：設水頭增至二十五公尺而導水能力不變，預測流量，再加入固定雨水流入求表觀比值，展示如何用乾雨時段分組避免錯誤判讀。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Increase head to twenty-five metres at unchanged conductance and predict flow, then add a fixed rainfall contribution and compute apparent conductance. Demonstrate how separating dry and wet periods prevents a misleading trend interpretation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：出口堵塞可使量到的排水量降低卻讓內部孔壓升高，不能把低流量一律視為改善；相反地雨水混入排水溝會提高比值，但不一定代表心層發生新的滲流通道。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Outlet blockage may lower measured drainage while raising internal pressure, so reduced flow is not automatically improvement. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 排水量的水頭正規化：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Head-normalized drainage conductance: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「排水量的水頭正規化」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Head-normalized drainage conductance” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 出口堵塞可使量到的排水量降低卻讓內部孔壓升高，不能把低流量一律視為改善；相反地雨水混入排水溝會提高比值，但不一定代表心層發生新的滲流通道。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Outlet blockage may lower measured drainage while raising internal pressure, so reduced flow is not automatically improvement. Rainwater entering a drain can raise apparent conductance without creating a new path through the core. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這個比值仍受降雨入滲、溫度黏度及出口堵塞影響；用石門土石壩背景討論趨勢時，應把量測位置、時滯與水頭定義清楚保留在完整趨勢圖上。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The ratio remains sensitive to rainfall infiltration, temperature-dependent viscosity and outlet blockage, so trend interpretation must retain measurement location, lag and the definition of hydraulic head rather than presenting one normalized value as a direct measure of erosion or structural condition.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「排水量降低一定表示壩內滲流風險下降」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Lower measured drainage always means reduced internal seepage risk" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.
